children: Hackett Group reported third-quarter 2026 total revenue of $69.8 million and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.14. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.39, at the high end of the company’s guidance range. The company forecast fourth-quarter revenue before reimbursements of $68 million to $70 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.39 to $0.41.
Total revenue was $69.8 million, including $68.9 million in revenue before reimbursements.
Reported segment gross margins were $17.3 million for Global S&BT, $6.2 million for Oracle Solutions and $7.5 million for SAP Solutions.
Operating income was $7.5 million, compared with $5.5 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Net income was $3.6 million, compared with $2.5 million a year earlier. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.14, versus $0.09.

Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.39, compared with $0.37 in the year-earlier quarter. For the fourth quarter, the company expects revenue before reimbursements of $68 million to $70 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.39 to $0.41.
The company said its XT and AIX AI platforms are being used more broadly in enterprise transformation and software implementation work, with early improvements to sales and delivery productivity.
Management highlighted Hackett’s transformation expertise, proprietary benchmarking and process intelligence as capabilities supporting clients’ AI transformation efforts.

The Global S&BT segment includes AI consulting, implementation and licensing, benchmarking, business transformation, executive advisory, market intelligence and IP-as-a-service offerings, alongside OneStream and eProcurement.
Hackett reported 1,210 consultants and 1,474 employees at quarter-end.
